## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Utilities, Energy). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology); confirmed by very weak sector breadth and major divergences among large caps (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +10.97%) ABOVE TREND.  
Energy follows: VLO (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +28.34%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.55% | 1M: +33.76%) ABOVE TREND.  
Technology shows pockets of strength: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +4.63%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Healthcare lagging: AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -11.92%) BELOW TREND.  
Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -15.91%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -11.53%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -6.38%) BELOW TREND.  
Technology internals mixed with many large-cap losers: MSFT (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +10.97%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +4.63%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -8.63% | 1M: -0.99%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -11.53%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -9.31% | 1M: +7.47%) CORRECTION, NVS (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -11.92%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Healthcare and select high-multiple Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +16.71%), VST (1W: +10.45%), ORCL (1W: +8.99%), CEG (1W: +8.84%), AMD (1W: +7.44%) — watch for profit-taking given narrow leadership. Significant downside momentum: SYK (1W: -14.63%), ADBE (1W: -12.13%), PANW (1W: -11.82%); this is a MAJOR divergence vs month trends, so watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed with narrow leadership and weak internals; INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +4.63%) ABOVE TREND while MSFT (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: Tech: 7/24 positive (internal rotation).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are mixed and not leading: JPM (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.83% | 1M: +1.88%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.13% | 1M: +1.41%) CORRECTION — Sector breadth: Financials: 4/20 positive (internal rotation).

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Defensive names bifurcated: JNJ (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +4.32%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +2.94% | 1M: -1.53%) RECOVERY, while AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND and SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: Healthcare: 3/17 positive (sector weakness).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor rotating toward Energy and Utilities exposure and selective Financials given leadership and income-style flows; reduce exposure to underperforming high-multiple Tech names showing 1W weakness. Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth given two-sector leadership and mixed Tech internals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through, VLO (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +28.34%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Utilities (Utilities: 8/10 positive) and Energy (Energy: 8/10 positive) for continuation.  
BEARISH: Healthcare (Healthcare: 3/17 positive) and Consumer Discretionary (weak internals) for potential further underperformance.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly follow-through would confirm broader Tech re-acceleration. Monitor INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold this week’s gains would signal reversion. AAPL (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — a flip to positive weekly momentum would reduce short-term risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
META (+50): Muse AI launch; price confirming at META (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned.  
AMZN (+50): Qualcomm/Amazon chips headline; price diverging as AMZN (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -6.38%) BELOW TREND — watch for follow-through.  
QCOM (+55): Qualcomm chip deal (news); monitor price action (sector/stock needs confirmation).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
META (-80): $18B settlement headline creates a large negative catalyst but price is ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.61%) — major news/price divergence to monitor.  
SYK (-50): supply-chain hit and large price drop confirm downside at SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND.  
ADBE (-45): negative pre-earnings headlines and ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Utilities and Energy leadership. INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +28.34%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major news/price divergence (META headlines conflicting) and narrow leadership — monitor for trend confirmation before adding exposure.
